rules.topic: Evolved Mekanism extends Mekanism's tier ladder with four tiers above ULTIMATE, in order: OVERCLOCKED, QUANTUM, DENSE, MULTIVERSAL (then CREATIVE). The new tiers apply across the addon: tiered solar/lunar/wind generators, tiered personal storage, and the addon's own machines; they are built from four new resources - better_gold, plaslitherite, refined_redstone and noctis_rozuli (EMResources.java lines 6-9; noctis_rozuli has overworld and deepslate ores)

Tiered solar and lunar generators multiply Mekanism's advanced solar generation rate (config defaults): ADVANCED x8, ELITE x32, ULTIMATE x128, OVERCLOCKED x512, QUANTUM x2048, DENSE x8192, MULTIVERSAL x32768, CREATIVE x131072 (lines 53-60); each tier is x4 the previous and the generator's internal buffer scales by the same multiplier (config comment, line 50)

rules.quote: public static final BlockRegistryObject<BlockTileModel<TileEntityChemixer, Machine<TileEntityChemixer>>, ItemBlockMachine> CHEMIXER = BLOCKS.register("chemixer", () -> new BlockTileModel<>(EMBlockTypes.CHEMIXER, properties -> properties.mapColor(BlockResourceInfo.STEEL.getMapColor())), ItemBlockMachine::new);
rules.topic: Beyond tiers, the addon adds its own processing machines - alloyer, chemixer, thermalizer (melter), solidification chamber, fluid combiner - and an APT multiblock line (casing, ports, supercharging elements); their recipes are jar data, so per-recipe numbers come from layer 1/2

The addon registers its tiers into Mekanism's own tier system rather than replacing it: base Mekanism mechanics and safety numbers (fission, fusion, SPS) are unchanged and are covered by the mekanism rule file (D55); Evolved Mekanism content sits on top
